name: animated-testimonials
blurb: Carousel of testimonials with rotating images and word-by-word text reveal.
description: Side-by-side layout with animated image carousel on left (rotating with random tilt, scale) and testimonial text on right. Text words animate in with blur effect. Includes previous/next buttons and optional autoplay.
use_when: Showcasing customer testimonials with visual interest via stacked image animation and sequential text reveal.
avoid_when: When motion should be minimal — multiple animation layers run continuously.
a11y: Images have alt text (name). Navigation buttons should have aria-labels (not currently present). No prefers-reduced-motion guard for animations.

props.name: testimonials
props.type: Array<{quote: string; name: string; designation: string; src: string}>
